Uses the current daily purchase scope, including cash withdrawals and outgoing external transfers included in that chart. Self-transfers, card settlements and installments are excluded. Purchases and refunds remain separate; actuals are net. No future refunds are assumed.
Cleaning, training and forecasting run on this device. Transactions are not sent to a server, and raw message text never enters the forecast model.
Starts when enabled. Historical evaluations are not presented as previously published forecasts.

The weekday median is the baseline. Huber regression with L2 learns weekday, salary-period position and recent behavior, reducing the influence of valid large payments without deleting them. Promotion requires at least 10% lower error and no measured horizon more than 10% worse.

Inputs: approved financial facts, amount, date, currency and links, 7- and 28-day averages, weekday, salary period and registered commitments. Recurrence needs three payments, weekly within two days or monthly within five days.
